Notes

::: {.hero-lead}
AI engineer and data scientist. Previous evolved form: evolutionary biologist. I spent years on population genetics and invasion biology -- tracking New Zealand mudsnails through national park waterways -- and I still think about problems the same way: observe carefully, model the uncertainty, explain it plainly.

Chicago-raised, Las Vegas-based, usually planning the next move. Find me outside with my miniature poodle -- or where the determinism of the lab meets the stochasticism of the real world.
:::
